caseName: Washington ex rel. Smith v. City of Seattle
caseNameFull: The State of Washington ex rel. Grant Smith, in Error v. The City of Seattle
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Washington.
attorneys: Mr. Harold Preston, Mr. Geo. Donworth and Mr. Elmer E. Todd for the plaintiffs in error. Mr. Howard A. Hanson for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Yazoo & Mississippi R. R. v. Adams, 180 U. S. 41, 44; St. Paul Gas Light Co. v. St. Paul, 181 U. S. 142; Cleveland & Pittsburg R. R. v. Cleveland, 235 U. S. 50, decided November 16, 1914.
